name: callbreak
description: Call Break: the trick-taking card game. Online 4-player game + in-person score-keeper, on Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --workspace=@callbreak/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@callbreak/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@callbreak/shared-logic --if-present && npm run build --workspace=@callbreak/web && npm run build --workspace=@callbreak/api
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.cf:web:deploy: npm run build --workspace=@callbreak/web && npx wrangler deploy --config web/wrangler.jsonc --env production
